verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.openai.com/llms.txt that indexes Plugins docs, and markdown docs pages that link back to an llms.txt index. A plugins-specific llms.txt (developers.openai.com/plugins/llms.txt) also exists, and the docs themselves are served as .md files an agent can ingest directly. missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, independent community confirmation of agents consuming these docs in practice.
